asr.full_text: Welcome to Mirror Trading International's official investor presentation. Mirror Trading International Pty Ltd is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 43 Plain Street in Stellenbosch in the Western Cape of South Africa. Johan Steenberg from Poloquani in South Africa is the CEO and founder. The attorneys and legal advisors of Mirror Tradingrotrading International are Olrich Roux and Associates who have their offices in Parkhurst, Johannesburg. The objective of Mirrotrading International is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is ALWAYS in Bitcoin, and you earn Bitcoin daily. This means the number of Bitcoin in your trading pool will increase day-by-day. This also means that when the price of bitcoin rises so too with the value of your trading account increase. MTI has a sustainable business model trading Forex Monday to Friday using advanced artificial intelligence software with Bitcoin as its base currency. The profitability of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activities. Your FULL bitcoin investment goes into your trading account. MTI provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading activities. Remember trade results are not guaranteed but no trading knowledge is required. In MTI there are no admin fees, no membership fees, no subscriptions, no packages, no costs and no deductions. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows 40% goes to you themember 20 % the binary bonus pool 5% to the P1 and P2 leadership bonus pool and 25% to the traders 10% to MTI for administration and to pay the referral bonuses please remember that historical results are no guarantee of future results all income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statement detailing the income from the trades for the day. These statements will be in your back office from Tuesday to Saturday. Your daily trade profits are automatically compounded. Withdrawals In MTI, there are no contracts, and no lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. And you can withdraw whenever you like. There are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Your requested amount will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. Providing you with a passive sustainable income, from your Bitcoin in Trade, is at the very heart of MIRROR Training International. To start you will need to register with MTI, and fund your account with Bitcoin. The suggested minimum is $100 worth of Bitcoin. Accounts not funded within 7 days will be deleted. However you may register again. That summarizes the passive part of the opportunity and as a member you will earn from the trading activities and grow your Bitcoin. Mirror Trading international has an optional referral program should you wish to refer your friends or new members. For more information please contact the person who sent you this

It advertises a daily return figure while stating that future returns are not guaranteed. the available video evidence does not establish that funds were accepted, trades occurred, withdrawals were completed, or the claimed affiliation and service operation were verified.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer links funding a Bitcoin trading account to passive trading income and compounding profits. The presentation expressly conditions income on positive trading results rather than guaranteeing returns.
